BackendCapabilitiesReply.description: Opaque report; the shape is owned by the capability negotiation module.

BackpressureReason.description:
Why a streaming or queued operation is currently throttled.

Closed enum: every reason is named, and drift between host and guest fails the serde `deny_unknown_fields`-equivalent path (variants must match). Detail strings carried alongside this enum are bounded and redacted — never argv / env / stdin / stdout / stderr / filesystem paths.

oneOf.description: Host could not reach the guest agent within the configured grace period. Typically resolves on the next probe.
One or more integration readiness probes are still pending.

pending.description: Names of services whose readiness scripts have not yet reported success. Echoed verbatim — never user payload.

oneOf.description: The host is not draining the data-plane stream fast enough, so the guest is holding back to honor the frame cap.
Bounded input ring is saturated. The producer must wait.
A chunked artifact transfer is paused (typically host disk pressure or quota).
The shared builder VM is occupied by another build; this run is queued behind it.
Read the host file, write it into the guest.
Read the guest file, write it to the host.

EgressTarget.description: One outbound destination the workload may reach. Each one lands in the signed plan's egress grant, which is what the host egress gate reads.

kind.description: File type. `Other` covers sockets, FIFOs, devices.

name.description: Bare entry name (no leading directory component).

size.description: Size in bytes, or `0` for non-files.

FsEntryKind.description: Type of a filesystem entry returned by `FsList` / `FsStat`.

GuestFsStatReply.description: Stat metadata for a single filesystem entry.

canonical_path.description: Canonical (post-`realpath`) path the agent operated on. Lets the host detect when a symlink resolution surprised it.

mode.description: Unix mode bits (e.g. `0o100644`). Always present; on backends without a unix mode the agent reports a best-effort equivalent.

mtime.description: Modification timestamp as RFC 3339, or `None` if the underlying fs doesn't expose mtime.

GuestFsStatReply.title: FsStat

argv0.description: argv\[0\] for display only — the agent does not expose the full argv over the wire (it could echo secrets the caller passed in via env / stdin).

done.description: The process has ended and the stream is closed.

outcome.description: How it ended; present exactly when `done`.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for a first chunk. At most [`MAX_WAIT_MS`].

timeout_secs.description: Bounds the wait on the guest; the stream ends `timed_out` past it.

truncated.description: Output past [`WAIT_OUTPUT_CAP`] on either stream was dropped.

InstanceReadiness.description:
Finer-grained "is this VM usable?" state, composed alongside the coarse [`InstanceStatus`] lifecycle.

`InstanceStatus::Running` means the backend accepted the VM and it has not stopped. `InstanceReadiness` explains *whether* it is actually usable: did the agent answer? Are integration probes green? Is a streaming operation currently throttled?

Readiness transitions are independent of lifecycle transitions — they do not gate or require `InstanceStatus` to move.

oneOf.description: Backend has accepted the launch request. No further signal from the guest yet.
Host is waiting for the guest agent on the assigned vsock port.
Guest agent answered protocol hello and capability negotiation succeeded.
Integration readiness probes are running; the listed services have not yet reported healthy.

pending.description: Services whose readiness scripts are still pending.

oneOf.description: Every integration's readiness contract is satisfied.
At least one previously-ready service has regressed to unhealthy.

unhealthy.description: Services whose health probe has flipped to unhealthy.

oneOf.description: A specific runtime resource is saturating; the workload is otherwise live.
Shutdown sequence has begun.

MachineCreateReply.description: A machine's observed runtime state — the shared listing/inspect record. Every field is REST-satisfiable plain data (no host handles, no paths, no keys), so the same struct crosses the gateway wire. New fields carry `#[serde(default)]` so an older serialized record still deserializes.

auto_resume.description: Whether connecting auto-resumes a sleeping machine.

backend.description: Backend that owns this machine (e.g. `"firecracker"`, `"hvf"`, `"libkrun"`). Empty when unknown.

cpus.description: vCPU count. `0` when unknown (e.g. a registered-but-stopped machine).

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 TTL expiry, when set. Whether it has elapsed is a caller (presentation) decision, not modeled here.

guest_ip.description: Guest IP, when networking is configured.

last_readiness_change_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last `readiness` change.

memory_mib.description: Guest memory in MiB. `0` when unknown.

profile.description: Flake profile name, when built from a profile.

revision.description: Nix store revision hash, when known.

status_detail.description: Free-text detail for a non-happy `status` — e.g. the reason behind [`MachineStatus::Failed`]. `None` when the status needs no elaboration. Kept off `MachineStatus` so that enum stays `Copy` and cheap to compare.

MachineCreateReply.title: MachineState

MachineCreateRequest.description: A `machine.create` request: a persistent definition, never booted here.
MachineCreateRequest.title: CreateRequest

MachineExecReply.description: A `machine.exec` reply. Stream bytes cross as base64, because JSON strings are not byte strings — the same convention as `machine.logs` and every `guest.*` payload.

force.description: Persistent only: recreate a same-name definition whose config differs.

image.description: What to boot: an OCI reference (optionally `oci:`-prefixed), an absolute or `./`-relative rootfs path, or `flake:<ref>#<attr>`.

name.description: Required for a persistent machine; generated for a transient one.
